about_the_game:
Stranded on a mysterious planet left behind by an ancient civilization, your goal is to find your way out through the alien ruins. Based on the research of your expedition, your last chance is to reach for the top, where the previous inhabitants of the planet left a beam open. While the destination of the beam is unclear, you know your only way is up. However, one wrong move might send you tumbling all the way down and return you to the mysterious Beacon that binds you to the planet. Jump, fall, and go again until you can break the loop and get out.

KEY FEATURES

  • Challenging vertical platforming: Master the responsive controls, precise platforming, and mid-air movement to navigate tricky jumps and daring leaps of faith.

  • Unlock new abilities: Progress unlocks more jumps and dashes, allowing you to solve even crazier jumps.

  • Atmospheric world: Explore the remnants of an ancient civilization through breathtaking visuals, relaxing sound design, and progressing mood and atmosphere.

  • Adjustable difficulty: Want to take the unforgiving challenge for the glory? Or explore the environment at your own pace and build checkpoints as you go? We got you covered.

  • One goal: Reach the top… But will you make it?

Inspired by the jumping puzzles of games like Destiny and Guild Wars 2 and the progressing mood and beauty of games like Journey, Jumpbound invites you to a proper challenge that ensures a relaxing experience even in the face of failure. Treat every fall as an opportunity to learn something new and face your fear of heights as you reach for the skies.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 or AMD equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2080 or AMD equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Jump and dash your way to the top in this challenging first-person platformer. Embark on an adventure through a mysterious world, unlock more mechanics as you progress, and make every jump count while enjoying the view and relaxing atmosphere.
